earlier_whole_concat_token_difference_ex: The remote migration ledger records 87 individually separated statements without semicolon terminators. Concatenating their text with no delimiters (the earlier fingerprint method) is NOT equivalent to the Git SQL file including terminators.
note: This corrects the interpretation of the B2.4/B3.2 initial-schema raw-content divergence; it does not rewrite the original fingerprint or approve SQL execution.
